newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch closing share market report.
newsitem.headline: Dutch closing share market report.

text.p: Dutch shares closed over one percent higher on the day and more than four percent above the previous week's close.
Prices jumped higher at the opening, taking their lead from another strong session on Wall Street, and traded in a fairly narrow range thereafter.
The AEX index of 25 blue chip shares closed 7.15 points or 1.14 percent higher at 632.71.
This left the AEX index just four points below the highs it reached before Fed chairman Alan Greenspan rattled equity markets with his "irrational exuberance" speech.

The AEX index has risen some 30 percent this year and Dutch equity analysts believe it should be able to rise another 10 percent in 1997 given a sound fundamental background of robust economic growth, rising company earnings and modest inflation.
Among individual shares, food group CSM stood out on Friday, closing up 3.90 guilders at 94.50, as the market welcomed its acquisition of U.S. bakery ingredients maker Karp's Inc.
ABN AMRO ended 1.90 firmer at 110.80 as the 2.5 billion guilder sale of its MeesPierson investment bank unit to Fortis was sealed. Fortis Amev shares firmed one guilder to 58.80.
